correctness.rationale: The comparison is equivalent to Omega_N>(N+2)^2/8. The source proves Omega_N>(N+1)^2/varpi^2 and an exact shooting sign test. An elementary 16-cell upper Riemann-style bound gives varpi<2.7, so for N=21+m the desired tail follows from 800(N+1)^2-729(N+2)^2=71m^2+1666m+1559>0. The only admissible even cases left are N=2,...,20. I independently replayed the exact rational interval algorithm from the frozen verifier and reproduced the strict crossing indices {2:1,4:3,6:4,8:6,10:8,12:9,14:11,16:13,18:14,20:16}, as well as the certified varpi upper bound 2.685341233...<2.7. Thus finite computation is exhaustive only for ten explicitly bounded cases, while the infinite tail is analytic. The ratio limit follows directly from the source asymptotic Omega_N/(N+1)^2 -> 1/varpi^2.
